item.title: Melbourne artist David Kaneen to hold painting exhibition in…
item.description: The Angelon Vima gallery in Athens is hosting a solo exhibition by Australian artist David W. Kaneen, running from March 1 to April 5, 2026. item.title: From ancestral threads to contemporary art: Inside Evangeleah…
item.description: At just 28, Evangeleah Plakias is presenting her work to the public for the first time – and doing so through a deeply personal exploration of Greek history, memory and identity.
